realized_capacity_note: The 3.23 req/s model capacity assumes decode batches run full (64 rows). The measured loop cannot sustain that: padded-cache rebuild cost scales with concurrency x context (and needs ~2x the KV when the padded batch is transient), so the first overloaded cell hit CUDA OOM at max_running=96 and the realized equilibrium was ~1.5-1.6 req/s. The frozen ladder is unchanged; two lower control points were added after measuring this, before any policy run completed.
